predictions: Sentences naming Soviet security organs, design bureaus, plants and administrative centres reach 0.25-0.8, peaking on the word before the name. The same frames with American, British or other non-Soviet institutions stay at 0.1-0.2 (they are not silent: the frame alone carries some activation).
